I have been farming this land near Lilongwe for many years. This season I was able to get two FISP coupons, so I will apply both bags of NPK and both bags of urea to this main 1.44-hectare maize plot, giving me about 48 kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare. I also have manure from my cattle and compost from the homestead that I will spread before planting, and since the FISP pack included hybrid seed, I will plant that rather than local maize. We depend entirely on the November rains here, so I will not irrigate. My children and I will do most of the ridging, planting, and weeding ourselves, but I will hire about fifteen ganyu workers when the weeding is heavy.
